jobs.title: AWS Engineer with .Net
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced AWS Cloud Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AWS infrastructure and cloud services, particularly EC2, CloudWatch, and Lambda. The candidate should have experience in managing cloud environments, monitoring application performance, troubleshooting issues, and supporting cloud-based applications. Knowledge of .NET development is required as a secondary skill.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Manage and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure, primarily EC2 instances.
Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot AWS CloudWatch for application and infrastructure monitoring.
Develop, deploy, and maintain serverless applications using AWS Lambda.
Monitor cloud resources, identify performance issues, and ensure high availability.
Handle cloud infrastructure troubleshooting, incident management, and production support.
Configure alerts, logs, metrics, and monitoring dashboards using CloudWatch.
Support application deployment, maintenance, and cloud environment upgrades.
Work on AWS security, IAM roles, access management, and resource optimization.
Collaborate with development and DevOps teams for cloud operations.
Support .NET-based applications and troubleshoot application-level issues.

Mandatory / Primary Skills:

Strong hands-on experience with AWS EC2.
AWS CloudWatch – Monitoring, Logs, Metrics and Alerts.
AWS Lambda – Deployment, Configuration and Troubleshooting.
AWS cloud infrastructure management and production support.
Cloud monitoring, incident management and troubleshooting.

Secondary Skills:

.NET Core / .NET Framework and C#.
REST API development and integration.
SQL Server and database knowledge.
CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
